business.name: ClearFlow Automation (fictional portfolio business)
business.description: A B2B provider that connects existing business software and automates repetitive office processes.
services: Routing customer enquiries and tracking quotation follow-ups
Order and inventory notifications between existing systems
Paid process discovery and narrowly scoped pilots
not_offered: Building a new SaaS product from scratch
Supplying or programming industrial robots or machinery
Website design or advertising campaigns without process automation

paid_discovery.description: Paid process mapping, requirements and a recommendation. No production deployment promised.

focused_pilot.description: One narrow workflow for one team, using at most two existing systems; limited testing, not a company-wide rollout.

standard_rollout.description: Several connected process steps or workflows for one department using existing systems.

enterprise_rollout.description: Multi-country/multi-site or cross-company deployment, extensive governance or mandatory unusual hosting. Human feasibility assessment before qualification.

business.assumptions: All prices, time limits and commercial rules are invented demo policy, not market prices or delivery guarantees. Readiness and budgets are customer statements, not independently verified facts.

important: No points for employer prestige, company size, job title, personal email provider or hypothetical future contract value.
Budget must refer to the CURRENT requested paid phase. A pilot budget does not fund a rollout.
A business priority score is not purchase probability. A high model probability is not independently calibrated confidence.
Unknown is not zero. Human-review, non-sales, hard-gated and on-hold cases are Not scored, never fake 0/100.
Support can be urgent without being a sales opportunity. Do not delete or auto-reject messages.
